messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: Getting error using rep_len in simple script
parts:
Jeff,

you are right: the rep_len function was introduced in 3.0.0: "There is a new function rep_len() analogous to rep.int() for when speed is required (and names are not)." (source: http://cran.xl-mirror.nl/src/base/NEWS.html)

Renjin is forked from GNU R version 2.14.2 so this function is not available in Renjin and you should use the rep.int function instead. Renjin will probably be synced with later versions of R at some point in time (it's been done in the past), but at the moment we are focusing on increasing general compatibility.

Regards,

Maarten-Jan Kallen
